countPolicy: project.delete: live affected tasks plus live direct child projects; task.moveTree: live whole subtree including root
requestPolicy: One nonnegative safe-integer upper bound applies separately to every fanout envelope; header is outside immutable canonical mutation bodies
retryPolicy: Every dispatch reserves its full cost; no refund. Exact accepted receipt precedes bound checks. Refresh and reestimate a stale bound with the same envelope, ID, sequence and digest.
overflowPolicy: Do not clamp the formula to the daily allowance; retain pending operations above that allowance for an explicitly approved one-attempt path
